hints.title: Single Character Deletion Trial
hints.text: Because the string length is small (at most 100), iterate over every character position and simulate removing it.

hints.title: Frequency Multiplicity Check
hints.text: For each candidate deletion, count frequencies of remaining characters and check if all non-zero counts are identical.

hints.title: Early Success Termination
hints.text: Return true as soon as any single character removal leaves all remaining characters with equal frequencies.

hints.title: Brute Force Character Removal Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing each of n character removals takes constant 26 alphabet checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Complex case analyses on frequency distributions often miss edge cases like singletons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed alphabet size 26 yields O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Simulates removal of each character index directly for robust edge-case handling.
